en.text:
Grants an additional Grenade Charge.

Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade ability over the span of ? seconds and enhances it once thrown.

Enhanced Behaviors:
• <void/>Axion Bolt gains 2 additional seekers, travels ?% further, deals 25% increased damage, and retriggers again 1 second after landing
• <void/>Scatter Grenade gains 4 additional submunitions, aggressively seeks targets within 5 meters, and deals 25% increased damage against Combatants
• <void/>Vortex Grenade gains 70% increased radius, 7.5% increased duration, pulls targets in and begins its damage 0.2 seconds sooner, and continously retriggers its pull every ? seconds
• <void/>Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall Grenade become a 'Handheld Supernova' and release a short-range blast of 9 high damage projectiles. Projectiles travel up to 12.5 meters away and apply <void/>Volatile on hit. Passively grants 15% increased Grenade Regeneration Speed
